title: Private City Manager Evaluation Marathon
summary:
*   Austin officials convened a lengthy closed-door meeting solely dedicated to the City Manager's performance evaluation.
*   The special session lasted seven hours, stretching from late afternoon into the late evening.
*   No public decisions, policy changes, or official actions were taken during this meeting.
